activity_summary: At dinner the penny loaf was still a finger short of the notch. Your board was threepence. Gib was on the stair and not on the book. You told the house you would write and that you would not send it. Hobbins had already gone with Thursday's packet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Confirmed the loaf and the board, and said the writing would stay in the house.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Named the short loaf and refused to carry a letter.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Left Gib on the stair and off the book.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in A finger short, still

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A finger short of the notch.
